_comment: Sharia-compliance ruling per EGX100 ticker. Used to build the "sharia" strategy universe (egx100 filtered to compliant:true) and shown in the dashboard Settings section. Seed: compliant:true == constituent of the official EGX 33 Shariah Index (screened by its Sharia supervisory board). Everything else is false, either a clear business-activity prohibition or "not individually screened". Edit via the dashboard Settings section, or here directly; the next bot cycle picks it up.
